savee.note: Official Savee hosted MCP server. Uses OAuth — on first connection the agent is prompted to authorize via browser; no API key to paste. Nine read tools (get_current_user, list_saves, get_save, list_feed, list_boards, list_board_saves, search, view_saves, list_comments); create_board, update_board, save_items, remove_save_from_board and add_comment only when the matching write scope is granted. Nothing deletes anything.
